verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API, GraphQL API, CLI (runpodctl), and two official MCP servers that together cover creating, starting, stopping, and terminating Pods, deploying Serverless endpoints, and monitoring/managing resources programmatically without console interaction. Agent skills docs explicitly describe an agent using natural language to create Pods, deploy endpoints, and run code end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of a full agent-driven provision-monitor-run-teardown loop via MCP/API (only vendor docs cited), and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable via probe.
